title: Harden GitHub Actions workflow permissions and pin external actions
description: Address CodeQL actions warnings by adding explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions to vscode-extension workflow and pinning external actions to immutable SHAs in vscode-extension and release workflows without changing behavior.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting implementation. Applying least-privilege permissions in vscode-extension workflow and pinning dorny/paths-filter plus softprops/action-gh-release to immutable commit SHAs. Then re-run rcql actions scan to verify warnings are resolved.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented workflow hardening changes and validated with fresh rcql actions scan. Results: Total 0 warnings after changes. Updated files: .github/workflows/vscode-extension.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml.
